Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement

For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT September 18, 2026

Recent economic developments

Recent indicators suggest that economic activity continued to expand at a solid pace. Job gains have remained strong, and the unemployment rate has stayed low. Real GDP is projected to grow by 1.8 percent in 2026.

Price developments

Inflation has eased over the past year but remains somewhat elevated. Inflation is expected to average 2.4 percent in 2026. Inflation expectations remain well anchored.

Risk assessment

The Committee remains attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate.

Forward guidance

In assessing the appropriate stance of monetary policy, the Committee will carefully assess incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks. The Committee's decisions will be data-dependent.
